preferred_translation: unification that comes forth from emptiness
alternative_translations: unification that comes forth from voidness
definition: Unification governed by, or coming forth from, the emptiness side of the emptiness / signless / wishless family.
notes: Keep this compound tied to suññatā as emptiness rather than treating it as interchangeable with signless or wishless compounds. This repository now prefers a fuller English rendering here so the compound does not read like a frozen technical label detached from practice. The compound inherits the headword's anti-nihilist and anti-mystifying policy, and voidness remains a controlled alternate when the Buddhadasa-line idiom itself is doing explanatory work.
version_notes: Revised 2026-11-08 by explicit editorial decision to follow Dhammarato's spoken usage in the 2014–2026 talk transcripts: follows the samādhi headword in its compact form.

example_phrases.pali: Suññato samādhi, animitto samādhi, appaṇihito samādhi
example_phrases.translation: unification that comes forth from emptiness, signless samadhi, wishless samadhi
example_phrases.notes: SN 43.4 names the three together as the path to the unconditioned; DN 33 lists them among the threes. Cited in the 2026-11-09 Wave 12 emptiness-cluster citation pass.
